symbolic_mapping: phone usage symbolizes competing temporal priorities
philosophy_interpretations.interpretation: The image visualizes a tension between immediate personal desire (watching a match) and deferred intellectual engagement (learning math), framing choice as a moment where attention is allocated across competing claims on time and meaning.
alternative_interpretations: The student may be using the phone for lecture-related purposes (e.g., checking solutions), and the speech bubble could be fictional or ironic.
limitations: The speech bubble is presented as diegetic text but cannot be verified as the student’s actual thought; it may be added post-hoc.

alternative_interpretations: The arrangement reflects standard classroom design for acoustic and visibility reasons, not intentional symbolic hierarchy.
limitations: No visible authority markers (e.g., name tag, uniform) confirm teacher/student roles definitively.
